display_long_description:
This is a pure arcade VR game focused on skill and score.
No waiting, no social pressure — just you, the game, and your performance.
As the difficulty increases, the gameplay becomes faster and more intense, demanding precision, reflexes, and full concentration.
This experience is only possible in VR, where physical movement and immersion are at the core of the gameplay.
Built for high replayability, every run is an opportunity to improve, push further, and beat your own score.
Unlike many VR games that rely heavily on social or multiplayer mechanics, this game is designed to be fun even when playing alone.
It’s quick to start, easy to understand, and challenging to master.
Early Access
The game is already fully playable, and this Early Access release is about shaping its future together with the community.
Planned updates include:
    • New maps
    • Multiplayer modes
    • Additional features based on player feedback
